主要内容: On January 5, 2017, Sangamo BioSciences, Inc. changed its corporate name to Sangamo Therapeutics, Inc. by filing the Third Certificate of Amendment of the Seventh Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation with the Secretary of State of Delaware. The amendment was approved by the Board of Directors on December 5, 2016, under Section 242 of the Delaware General Corporation Law, which allows such changes without stockholder approval. The name change does not affect the rights of security holders, and the company’s common stock continues to trade on The NASDAQ Global Market under the symbol SGMO. A press release announcing the name change was issued on January 6, 2017.
